observations: White sewing machine head mounted on a red wooden treadle table
Visible chipped paint and scuffs on the machine head
Treadle base with foot pedal, drive belt, and metal treadle plate
No power cord visible; appears to be manual treadle operation
QUICK CHARGE sign visible in background of multiple photos
General wear and age-related marks on the wooden table surface

claims.evidence: Photos show chipped paint on the machine head, scratches on the table, and visible wear consistent with age and use

risks.risk: Sewing machine may not stitch or form stitches properly
risks.proof: Video of the machine stitching a piece of fabric

risks.risk: Treadle mechanism may be stiff, seized, or broken
risks.proof: Video of the treadle being operated and the wheel turning smoothly

risks.risk: Wooden table may have loose joints, cracks, or structural damage
risks.proof: Close-up photos of table legs, joints, and underside

risks.risk: Missing bobbins, needles, presser feet, or other accessories

proof_requests: Video of the sewing machine stitching fabric
Video of the treadle being operated
Close-up photos of the table joints and underside
response.reason: The item is clearly a treadle sewing machine; the seller's claim of perfect condition is contradicted by visible wear, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-working unit pending proof.
